decision_conditions:
FLAT ROOF NOT USED AS AMENITY SPACE (COMPLIANCE): Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), the use flat roof of the outrigger extension hereby approved (at first floor level as shown on approved drawing no. PR-A1.03) shall be as set out in the application and no development (including the formation of any door) providing access to the roof shall be carried out, nor shall the roof area be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

REASON: In order to protect the privacy and amenity of neighbouring occupiers.
description: Erection of additional storey to existing rear part-width outrigger and erection of single storey lower ground floor rear extension with associated external patio space and external terrace above.
